claim_1.claim: Illumina gene array analysis of whole blood from 15 YF17D-vaccinated individuals in the Montreal cohort at days 0, 3, 7, 10, 14, 28, and 60 after vaccination showed that gene expression modulation peaked at days 3 and 7 after vaccination compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: The peak of modulation of gene expression, as shown by heat map representation (Fig. 1 a) and principal component analysis (Fig. 1 b), primarily occurred at days 3 and 7 after vaccination, whereas a limited number of significant genes were modulated in response to vaccination at day 10 after vaccination or beyond.

Figure 1. Vaccination with YF17D induces early gene modulation. Global view of gene modulation in total blood cells after YF17D vaccination, as analyzed by gene array on the Montreal cohort (n = 9–15, depending on the time point). Heat map representation (a) and PCA (b) using the significantly modulated genes, in at least one comparison versus day 0.

claim_2.claim: Illumina gene array analysis of whole blood from 15 YF17D-vaccinated individuals in the Montreal cohort at days 0, 3, 7, 10, 14, 28, and 60 after vaccination showed that TLR-associated genes (TLR7, MYD88, and IRF7) and IFN-induced genes (IFI27, IFI30, G1P2, G1P3, and OAS1-3) were up-regulated early after vaccination compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Some Toll-like receptor (TLR)-associated genes (TLR7, MYD88, and IRF7) were also up-regulated, leading to the activation of the IFN pathway, as monitored by the induction of several IFN-induced genes (IFI27, IFI30, G1P2, G1P3, and OAS1-3; Fig. 3 a and Supplemental document 1).

Figure 3. YF17D vaccination stimulates multiple arms of the innate and adaptive immunity. (a–e) Heat map representation of significantly modulated genes, P values listed with each gene indicate the largest (least significant) P value among the significant fold changes. n = 9–15, depending on the time point. The listed genes fall under different functional categories: IFN-induced and TLR-associated genes (a); complement-associated genes (b); macrophage-associated genes (c); NK cell-associated genes (d); and B cell-associated genes (e).

claim_3.claim: Illumina gene array analysis of whole blood from 15 YF17D-vaccinated individuals in the Montreal cohort at days 0, 3, 7, 10, 14, 28, and 60 after vaccination showed that complement-associated genes (C1QA, C1QB, C3AR1, and SERPING1) were up-regulated in blood cells early after vaccination compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Components of the complement system (C1QA, C1QB, C3AR1, and SERPING1) were found to be up-regulated in blood cells early after vaccination (Fig. 3 b).

Figure 3. YF17D vaccination stimulates multiple arms of the innate and adaptive immunity. sources.quote: A few macrophage/DC-associated genes were induced significantly by the vaccine, including CD86 (a marker of DC maturation), CSF1R, MARCO, and IFI16, which are expressed by cells of the monocyte-macrophage lineage (Fig. 3 c).

Figure 3. YF17D vaccination stimulates multiple arms of the innate and adaptive immunity. sources.quote: NK cell-associated genes (KIR2DL3, KIR2DL4, PRF1, GNLY, and GZMB) were also up-regulated (Fig. 3 d).

Figure 3. YF17D vaccination stimulates multiple arms of the innate and adaptive immunity. sources.quote: Genes associated with B cell activation (BANK1, CD19, IGJ, TNFRSF13B, and TNFRSF17l; Fig. 3 e) were also modulated.

claim_7.claim: Quantitative real-time PCR analysis of RNA from 7 volunteers from the Montreal cohort at days 0 and 7 after vaccination showed a highly significant correlation with the gene microarray results for 43 selected genes.

sources.quote: As shown in Fig. S2 (available at http://www.jem.org/cgi/content/full/jem.20082292/DC1), we could observe a highly significant correlation between the results obtained by qPCR and those obtained by gene microarray, with coefficients of correlation ranging between 0.78 and 0.96.

claim_8.claim: Illumina gene array analysis of whole blood from the Montreal and Lausanne cohorts at days 0, 3, and 7 after vaccination showed that inflammasome-associated genes caspase-1 and caspase-5 and IL-1-associated genes IL-1R2 and IL-1RN were modulated after YF17D vaccination compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Our gene array results showed that two components of the inflammasome, caspase-1 and -5, were up-regulated at the mRNA level in the Montreal cohort, 3 d after vaccination with YF17D (Fig. 5 a). Two other genes related to IL-1β production and signaling that were modulated by the vaccine are IL-1R2 and -1RN. All of these genes, except for caspase-5, were also similarly modulated in the Lausanne cohort.

Figure 5. YF17D induces expression of genes associated with IL-1β and activates the inflammasome. (a) Heat maps showing the up-regulation of genes encoding inflammasome components and the modulation of other, IL-1β-associated genes.

claim_9.claim: ELISA analysis of supernatants from monocyte-derived DCs incubated with live, UV-inactivated, or heat-inactivated YF17D showed that live or UV-inactivated YF17D induced markedly increased IL-1β secretion compared to DCs incubated in medium alone.

sources.quote: The results show that DCs incubated with live or UV-inactivated YF17D showed a marked increased IL-1β secretion (up to ninefold, compared with DCs incubated in medium alone), whereas heat-inactivated YF17D only triggered a modest secretion of the proinflammatory cytokine (Fig. 5 b and Fig. S4, available at http://www.jem.org/cgi/content/full/jem.20082292/DC1).

Figure 5. YF17D induces expression of genes associated with IL-1β and activates the inflammasome. (b) IL-1β production by monocyte-derived DCs incubated with live (YF), UV-inactivated (UV), or heat-inactivated (HI) YF17D, as determined by ELISA.

claim_10.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of PBMCs from 6 volunteers at days 0, 3, 7, 10, 14, and 28 after vaccination showed that Ki67+ CD4+CD8− and CD4−CD8+ T-cell frequencies increased within the first 14 days after YF17D vaccination compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: An increase in frequencies of Ki67+ cells in the CD4+CD8− (2.3-fold increase; P = 0.0049) and the CD4−CD8+ (4.7-fold increase; P = 0.0157) populations occurred within the first 14 d after YF17D vaccination, and then decreased to insignificant levels.

claim_11.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of PBMCs from 6 volunteers at days 0, 3, 7, 10, 14, and 28 after vaccination showed that Ki67+ NK-cell and non-T-cell PBMC frequencies increased within the first 7 days after YF17D vaccination compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: The Ki67+ NK cell population (CD3−CD8Dim; 1.6-fold; P = 0.0474) and non–T cell PBMCs containing monocytes and B cells (CD3−CD4−CD8−; 1.9-fold; P = 0.009) also increased in frequency within the first 7 d and reached insignificant levels thereafter.

claim_12.claim: CFSE labeling analysis of PBMCs sampled at day 60 after vaccination from YF17D-vaccinated volunteers showed that the breadth of CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell proliferative responses to 22 YF17D-derived peptide pools was highly variable among vaccinated individuals compared to other vaccinated individuals.

sources.quote: Both the CD4+ and CD8+ T cell proliferative responses were highly variable among the vaccinated volunteers.
Figure 6. YF17D induces a mixed Th1/Th2 response. (a) Day 60 PBMCs were stimulated with the 22 peptide pools and assayed by CFSE labeling for their proliferative response.

claim_13.claim: CFSE labeling analysis of PBMCs sampled at day 60 after vaccination from YF17D-vaccinated volunteers showed that CD4+ T-cell proliferative responses were broader than CD8+ T-cell proliferative responses to YF17D-derived peptide pools.

sources.quote: The CD8+ responses were generally much weaker than those observed in CD4+ T cells, and although only 2 responders recognized 19 of the pools (YF001 and 020), 10 of them recognized < 5.
Figure 6. YF17D induces a mixed Th1/Th2 response. (a) Day 60 PBMCs were stimulated with the 22 peptide pools and assayed by CFSE labeling for their proliferative response.

claim_14.claim: CFSE labeling analysis of PBMCs sampled at day 60 and day 365 after vaccination from YF17D-vaccinated volunteers showed that CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell peptide-specific proliferative responses were persistent compared to baseline after vaccination.

sources.quote: Both CD4+ and CD8+ T cell peptide-specific responses were persistent, as memory proliferative responses to the most immunodominant peptide pools were detected as long as 1 yr after immunization (unpublished data).

claim_15.claim: Cytometric bead assay analysis of PBMC supernatants from YF17D-vaccinated volunteers after stimulation with YF17D-derived peptide pools at day 60 after vaccination showed that both Th1 and Th2 cytokine secretion profiles were induced in most volunteers compared to nonresponse.

sources.quote: In most volunteers (12 out of 15), both Th1 and Th2 cytokine secretion profiles were induced by YF17D peptide pools.
Figure 6. YF17D induces a mixed Th1/Th2 response. At 24 h of culture, supernatants were analyzed by CBA to determine the Th1/Th2 cytokine secretion profile in response to each pool.

claim_16.claim: Polychromatic flow cytometry analysis of PBMCs from vaccinated volunteers at day 28 after vaccination showed that YF17D-specific CD4+CD154+ T cells expressed IL-2 alone, IFN-γ alone, or both after stimulation with immunostimulatory peptide pools compared to unstimulated cells.

sources.quote: As illustrated in Fig. 7 a, 35.2% of CD4+CD154+ cells expressed IL-2 alone, 8.6% expressed IFN-γ alone, and 29.5% expressed both IL-2 and IFN-γ.

Figure 7. YF17D vaccination induces specific CD4+ T cells of mixed T helper phenotype. (a) PBMCs from YF17D-vaccinated volunteers (day 28 after vaccination) were stimulated with a group of three immunostimulatory YF17D-derived peptides pools, and then stained with antibodies against CD4 (surface) and CD154, IL-2, and IFN-g (intracellular).

claim_17.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of PBMCs from four volunteers at day 365 after vaccination showed that both Th1 and Th2 central memory T cells could be detected after stimulation with YF17D peptide pools compared to background stimulation alone.

sources.quote: However, both Th1 and Th2 central memory T cells could be detected in all four volunteers tested.

Figure 7. YF17D vaccination induces specific CD4+ T cells of mixed T helper phenotype. (b) FACS analysis of PBMCs from day 365 after vaccination. Cells from four volunteers were stimulated (S) with immunostimulatory YF17D peptide pools, and then restimulated (RS) or not with the same peptide pools before staining. The data were analyzed according to the gating strategy shown in Fig. S7, and are expressed as the percentage of central memory CD4+ T cells (CD45RA−CCR7+) that express the marker for recent activation CD154, and that are either Th1 or Th2 in the RS samples, over background (S).

claim_18.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of DC/T cell co-cultures from YF-naive individuals after 14 days of culture showed that DCs pulsed with live or UV-inactivated YF17D primed a strong antigen-specific response of naive T cells compared to no antigen-pulsed DCs.

sources.quote: As shown in Fig. 8 a, DCs pulsed with YF17D virus (live or UV-inactivated) primed a strong antigen-specific response of naive T cells, with up to 4% cells expressing CD154 and IFN-γ in response to live or UV-inactivated YF17D.

Figure 8. YF17D elicits robust and diverse primary T helper cell responses in DC/T cell co-cultures. (a and b) Purified T helper cells were mixed with DCs that had been incubated with live or UV-inactivated YF17D. After 14 d, the cells were harvested and evaluated by flow cytometry for cytokine and CD154 expression after a short restimulation with autologous DCs targets that had been left untouched, pulsed with killed YF17D, or infected with live YF17D.

claim_19.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of DC/T cell co-cultures from YF-naive individuals after 14 days of culture showed that YF17D-pulsed DCs stimulated high numbers of antigen-specific Th2 cells expressing IL-5 and IL-13 upon restimulation with live or inactivated virus compared to no antigen-pulsed DCs.

sources.quote: Similarly, YF17D-pulsed DCs stimulated high numbers of antigen-specific Th2 cells expressing IL-5 and IL-13, upon restimulation with live or inactivated virus (Fig. 8 b).

Figure 8. YF17D elicits robust and diverse primary T helper cell responses in DC/T cell co-cultures. (a and b) Purified T helper cells were mixed with DCs that had been incubated with live or UV-inactivated YF17D. After 14 d, the cells were harvested and evaluated by flow cytometry for cytokine and CD154 expression after a short restimulation with autologous DCs targets that had been left untouched, pulsed with killed YF17D, or infected with live YF17D.

claim_20.claim: Multiplex cytokine analysis of DC/T cell co-culture supernatants from YF-naive individuals after 14 days of culture showed that when YF17D was used as pulse and recall antigen, the cells produced high levels of IL-2, IFN-γ, IL-13, and IL-5, but not IL-10, compared to co-cultures with no recall antigen.

sources.quote: When YF17D was used as pulse and recall antigen, the cells produced high levels of all the cytokines measured except IL-10, compared with co-cultures with no recall antigen.

Figure 8. YF17D elicits robust and diverse primary T helper cell responses in DC/T cell co-cultures. (c) Alternatively, the culture supernatants were harvested and evaluated by a multiplex cytokine analysis.

claim_21.claim: Microarray analysis of cells from YF17D-pulsed DC and CD4+ T-cell co-cultures at day 7 compared to day 0 showed that ETS2, STAT1, IRF1, IRF7, IRF8, GATA1, LMO2, and JUN transcriptional nodes were consistently induced after antigen exposure compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Gene modulation in response to the antigen (day 7 vs. 0) was assessed by microarray analysis. In total, eight nodes of transcriptional regulation of downstream target genes were consistently identified; ETS2, STAT1, IRF1, IRF7, IRF8, GATA1, LMO2, and JUN (Fig. 9).

Figure 9. Consensus transcriptional network of genes differentially expressed on day 7 as compared with day 0. Network representation of inferred transcription factors and predicted target genes that are consistently modulated in at least two out of three datasets, with the third dataset not being contradictory.
